21212.d: Rashiliyia's Tomb is the final burial ground for the zombie queen Rashiliyia.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
To get to the tomb, go north beyond the temple of Ah Za Rhoon. More specifically, it's southeast of the Fairy ring DKP on the east side of the river on Karamja. There will be ancient, stone doors in the ground to enter, provided a bone key is used on them after cleaning off the foliage. The key may be re-bought after the quest from Yanni Salika.

If you have access to the gnome glider network, then teleport to Al Kharid, take the glider to the Gnome Stronghold, then take the glider to "gandius" (Karamja). From there run north to reach the northern coast of Karamja.

g.how: {{Map}} on wiki page 'Rashiliyia's Tomb'

21213.d: Rasial's Citadel is where Rasial, the First Necromancer resides in the Underworld.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
The citadel is accessible during and after the quest The Spirit of War.
• Use the boss portal in War's Retreat.
• Use the boss portal in the Max Guild (requires 99 in every skill).
• Travel by Kharen's gondola in the north-west of the City of Um. This can be reached by running north from the City of Um lodestone, or by running south from the Ed's Boatyard station of the ferry system.
